schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE TRIANGLE (
    X INT,
    Y INT,
    Z INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (X, Y, Z),
    CHECK (X > 0),
    CHECK (Y > 0),
    CHECK (Z > 0)
);
